verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server documented on the AgentOS page. AgentOS is described as a toolkit that lets AI agents act on a production Airwallex account: reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards and building cashflow reports. A separate developer connector links coding agents such as Cursor, Claude Code and Codex to Airwallex docs and the sandbox. Missing for 10: detailed setup docs (transport, auth flow, full tool list) in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works.
